description: Defines the ImportCacheFiles class, a static utility class for managing cache filenames and cache file operations related to import processes in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: ImportCacheFiles
classes.description: A static class providing methods to generate, access, and manage cache filenames used during import operations in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getImportDir
methods.description: Returns the import directory path used for cache files.

methods.name: convertFileNameToUrl
methods.description: Converts a filename into a URL for downloading import error files.

methods.name: _createFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for a specific cache file type, based on current user and import directory.

methods.name: ensureWritable
methods.description: Checks if all cache files and their directories are writable or can be created.

methods.name: getDuplicateFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename for duplicate records download.

methods.name: getDuplicateFileDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the filename for displaying duplicate records in HTML.

methods.name: getErrorFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename for error logs.

methods.name: getErrorRecordsFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename for error records.

methods.name: getErrorRecordsWithoutErrorFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename for error records without associated error logs.

methods.name: getStatusFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename for status tracking.

methods.name: clearCacheFiles
methods.description: Deletes all CSV cache files in the import directory.
